## Summary
A clear, one-line description of the feature you're proposing.

## Problem it solves
What limitation or friction does this address? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution
Describe how you'd like it to work. Pseudocode, diagrams, or references to similar systems are welcome.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you've thought about?

## Additional context
Hardware setup, use case, links to related work, etc.
